_provenance.incident: On 2026-08-03 a five-seed comparison of a K=1 arm against a K=3 arm finished with complete separation at p=0.004 and was WITHDRAWN in full: both arms had ablated one direction per layer, so it compared two searches rather than two direction budgets. This is the arm labelled K=3.
_provenance.documented_at: this project's 2026-08-03 session record, 'The K arms did not test K'
_provenance.inferred: The per-layer extraction list. The record establishes the ceiling and the applied count; the list is written here as what a search with that ceiling would plausibly have kept, and it is what makes the second finding visible.
_provenance.not_reproduced: The five seeds, the p-value, and the statistics that produced it. The withdrawal is the record; the arithmetic behind it is not reconstructed.
